first_research_wake.runtime_behavior: The deterministic unscoped branch name caused Generation 006 to treat the historical branch as current work and enter non-plan recovery instead of performing a fresh transition audit.
first_research_wake.recovery_response_shape: legacy patch-style object using type/file/patch instead of complete action/path/content operations

primary_failures.detail: Runtime branch names were deterministic by research frontier only and did not isolate Meta-PDSA generations. The surviving Generation 005 transition branch therefore hijacked Generation 006 before a new transition decision could be evaluated.

The recovery analyst returned a PATCH/file/type operation object. The controller correctly rejected it fail-closed because apply_operations accepts only complete write/delete action/path/content operations, but the pre-START probe did not exercise this recovery contract.

intervention_accounting_at_stop.note: No human proof hint, lemma, definition, route, assumption, queue change, or research-development instruction was supplied after START. The owner authorized only a Meta-PDSA technical repair after the fail-closed controller error.

meta_learning: A valid START is insufficient if mutable runtime branch names can survive from a stopped generation and be mistaken for current work.
Cross-generation isolation must be enforced before START at the Git reference/PR layer, not assumed from state-file generation labels alone.
Historical autonomous research branches must remain preserved as evidence but must not retain the live deterministic names used by a fresh generation.
The recovery role needs a real pre-START schema probe for complete write/delete operation objects; transition/provider probes alone do not cover this failure mode.
The fail-closed operation validator worked correctly: the malformed patch was not applied.
next_meta_pdsa_scope: During fresh pre-START commission, detect historical runtime research branches using live deterministic autonomy names and quarantine them under generation-specific archive refs before research autonomy can START.
Fail commission if such a branch has an open PR or if archive preservation cannot be proven exact.
Extend provider preflight to exercise the recovery_analyst complete-operation contract and reject patch/diff/tool aliases before START.
Bind commission, provider preflight, dry run, and START evidence to Generation 007 and require fresh exact-head evidence.
forbidden_in_meta_repair: Do not reuse, merge, reinterpret, or alter the Generation 005 AUTO_CONTINUE transition conclusion on closed PR #14.
Do not evaluate the 014-to-015 transition gate during Meta-PDSA.
